description: Database specification for a mobile friendly tennis court reservation app.

bookingRules.overlapRule: A court cannot have two active bookings whose time intervals overlap. Use half-open intervals [startAt, endAt).
bookingRules.availabilityRule: Availability is calculated from court operating hours and active bookings. Do not store a manually maintained free/booked flag; it can become stale.

loyalty.rewardFrequency: one discount code is issued for each completed group of 10 bookings
loyalty.countRule: Cancelled bookings do not count. Count completed bookings for the user; issue a reward once when the count reaches each new multiple of 10. Enforce one reward per user and milestone.
loyalty.redemptionRule: A discount code may be redeemed once, by its owner, on a future confirmed booking.

users.description: Customers and caretaker accounts. Store password hashes only; never store plaintext passwords.

courts.description: Tennis courts. Indoor/outdoor and hard/grass are separate properties because they describe different characteristics.

bookings.description: A user's reservation of one court for a time interval. Hourly rate and totals are snapshots so later price changes do not alter past bookings.
constraints: endAt must be later than startAt
duration in minutes must be at least configuration.bookingRules.minimumDurationMinutes and a multiple of configuration.bookingRules.durationIncrementMinutes
grossPriceEUR = hourlyRateEUR * durationMinutes / 60, rounded to two decimal places
hourlyRateEUR is copied from the user's membershipType when the booking is confirmed
Only confirmed bookings block court availability; completed bookings remain in history; cancelled bookings do not block availability or count toward rewards
For the same court, confirmed booking intervals must not overlap

discountCodes.description: Single-use reward codes issued to users after successful booking milestones.
constraints: earnedAtBookingCount must be a multiple of configuration.loyalty.successfulBookingsPerReward
A code can only be redeemed by its owner and once
A code can only be used for a booking whose status is confirmed

businessRules: Show a court as booked for a requested time when a confirmed booking overlaps that interval; otherwise show it as available if the court is active and open for play.
Customers may browse availability and reserve active courts. The caretaker may view all bookings, including customer name, court, and time, and see availability across all courts.
The caretaker view and customer account details require authenticated access. Do not expose customer names or email addresses in public availability results.
Calculate each booking price using the member or external hourly price at confirmation time, then store the applied hourly rate on the booking.
Maintain the successful booking count as a derived value: count bookings for the user with status completed. Do not rely on a separately edited counter.
When a completed booking changes a user's count to a new multiple of 10, issue one unique discount code and record the corresponding milestone in discountCodes.

Validate availability and insert a booking atomically so two simultaneous requests cannot reserve the same court and overlapping time. Use a database exclusion constraint or transaction with locking, depending on the chosen database.

derivedValues.successfulBookingCount: COUNT(bookings.id) WHERE bookings.userId = user.id AND bookings.status = 'completed'
derivedValues.availabilityStatus: 'booked' if an active booking overlaps the requested interval, otherwise 'available' for an active court

implementationNotes: This file describes the data model and rules; it is not itself a running database.
The JSON Schema field types are descriptive metadata. Implement the entities as relational tables or equivalent collections in the database chosen by the project.
The discount amount and validity period were not specified in the assignment and must be agreed by the project team before discount codes can be redeemed.
Court opening hours and closure dates were not specified. Add an opening-hours/closures entity if the app must prevent reservations outside club operating times.
